purpose: Test whether seed-output differences between four reference and uniformly shifted visitor-optimum configurations remain after total pollen DELIVERY (not just export) is exactly matched, while holding diploid genotype and N/K/B fixed.
source_reproduction_kernel: unchanged Model3 reproduce_kb; delayed selfing; evolving assurance
root_bracket: find monotonic scalar activity root of total delivered pollen = total reference delivered; expand up to 1048576; explicit unmatchable status if shifted reach cannot equal target; never drop a failed block
existing_export_match_audit: must independently reproduce the prior 108-row source base and shifted raw cells; no alteration to source model

prediction.monomorphic: When recipient plants are genetically identical, they have equal ovules and selfing fraction; for exchangeable maternal pollen receipts, group viable seeds are a deterministic function of total delivered pollen. Exactly delivery-matched arms should show essentially zero seed difference. This is a source-kernel algebraic negative control, not biological generality.
prediction.mixed_diploid: Matching total delivered pollen alone may leave maternal receipt distribution and genotype-dependent selfing/ovules different. If viable seed difference persists, total receipt is insufficient; if not, the previous discrepancy can be attributed to delivery quantity within this model fixture, not to experimentally observed ecological composition.
prediction.failure: If any block cannot achieve delivery matching at attainable source activity, mark it unmatchable and report count and optimization boundary explicitly; do not silently exclude, refit or claim 36 successful matches.

limits: No explicit visit intensity or empirical pollinator efficacy
No causal decomposition of fitness vs population persistence
